cases.prompt: How do I run the tests in this project?
cases.expectedTranscript: How do I run the tests in this project?
cases.notes: Same sentence as en-synthetic-v1's en-run-tests, so the only variable is the speaker.

cases.prompt: What is the difference between a stateless and a stateful widget?
cases.expectedTranscript: What is the difference between a stateless and a stateful widget?
cases.notes: Same sentence as en-synthetic-v1's en-widget-question, so the only variable is the speaker.

cases.prompt: Can you explain what the LiteRT runtime does?
cases.expectedTranscript: Can you explain what the LiteRT runtime does?
cases.notes: Same sentence as en-synthetic-v1's en-litert, so the only variable is the speaker.

cases.prompt: Show me the latest commits on the main branch.
cases.expectedTranscript: Show me the latest commits on the main branch.
cases.notes: Same sentence as en-synthetic-v1's en-commits, so the only variable is the speaker.

cases.prompt: I think the download failed. Can you try again?
cases.expectedTranscript: I think the download failed. Can you try again?
cases.notes: Same sentence as en-synthetic-v1's en-download-failed, so the only variable is the speaker.

cases.prompt: Remind me to check the microphone permissions later.
cases.expectedTranscript: Remind me to check the microphone permissions later.
cases.notes: Same sentence as en-synthetic-v1's en-remind-mic, so the only variable is the speaker.

cases.prompt: Dart test is failing on the second case.
cases.expectedTranscript: Dart test is failing on the second case.
cases.notes: Same sentence as en-synthetic-v1's en-dart-test, so the only variable is the speaker.

cases.prompt: Open the settings and turn the voice off.
cases.expectedTranscript: Open the settings and turn the voice off.
cases.notes: Same sentence as en-synthetic-v1's en-settings-voice, so the only variable is the speaker.

cases.prompt: Can you — actually, can you show me the last three commits instead?
cases.expectedTranscript: Can you — actually, can you show me the last three commits instead?
cases.notes: A self-correction mid-sentence. Read speech never has these and the standing caveat on every corpus in this repo is that spontaneous speech is harder.

cases.prompt: So, um, I want to know why the download keeps failing.
cases.expectedTranscript: So, um, I want to know why the download keeps failing.
cases.notes: Fillers. Whisper is known to drop or hallucinate around them.

cases.prompt: Does Gemma run through LiteRT or through MLX on this Mac?
cases.expectedTranscript: Does Gemma run through LiteRT or through MLX on this Mac?
cases.notes: Three terms from builtInVocabulary in one breath. The recogniser is given this list, so this measures whether the help lands.

cases.prompt: Open Xcode and run the Swift tests, then tell me what Dart test says.
cases.expectedTranscript: Open Xcode and run the Swift tests, then tell me what Dart test says.
cases.notes: Product names that are also ordinary English words — swift, dart — which is the case a vocabulary list cannot disambiguate by spelling alone.

cases.prompt: Flutter three point forty-four point one, and the gate has twenty-one steps.
cases.expectedTranscript: Flutter three point forty-four point one, and the gate has twenty-one steps.
cases.notes: Numbers are scored separately: heardCer removes them from both sides, so this case is the only way to see them.
One word. The shortest thing a person says to a machine, and the case an endpointer is most likely to swallow.

cases.prompt: I think the 語音 part is broken, not the model.
cases.expectedTranscript: I think the 語音 part is broken, not the model.
cases.notes: Mostly English with one Chinese word — the reverse of every code-switching case measured so far, all of which were Chinese sentences carrying English terms.

cases.prompt: The thing I actually want is… a way to tell which recogniser is listening.
cases.expectedTranscript: The thing I actually want is… a way to tell which recogniser is listening.
cases.notes: A mid-sentence pause of about 1.2 s. voice-turn-latency.md records real pauses of 1.02 s in the zh corpus; this asks whether the same thing happens in English.
